buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 2. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS (ATC) PROCUREMENT OF PROCESSED CHEESE SPREAD – 200 G PACK FOR OFFICERS' RATION 1. SCHEDULE OF REQUIREMENT No. of Pack Ser Item Pack Size Required Qty Total Qty s 1 Processed Cheese Spread200 g 72 Kg 360 Packs 72 Kg Total 72 Kg 360 Packs 72 Kg Quantity in words: Seventy-Two Kilograms only. Calculation: Processed Cheese Spread: 360 × 200 g = 72 Kg The supplier shall supply 360 sealed retail packs of 200 g each for Processed Cheese Spread.

2. TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION A. PROCESSED CHEESE SPREAD (a) Item shall be Processed Cheese Spread, suitable for human consumption and conforming to the late st applicable FSSAI standards/regulations. (b) Each retail pack shall contain 200 g net quantity. (c) Product shall conform to the applicable compositional requirements, including: Maximum Moisture – 60% Minimum Milk Fat – 40% on dry matter basis Maximum Lactose – 5%, wherever applicable (d) Product shall be smooth, homogeneous and readily spreadable, with characteristic taste, flavour, colou r and odour. (e) Product shall be free from mould, rancidity, abnormal/off odour, foreign matter, contamination and adu lteration. (f) The product shall not be substituted with cheese analogue, cheese-flavoured spread or any other non-c onforming product. 3. FSSAI & STATUTORY REQUIREMENTS (a) Manufacturer/Supplier shall possess a valid FSSAI Licence/Registration applicable to the offered pro duct. (b) The product shall conform to the latest applicable FSSAI standards and regulations prevailing at the tim e of supply. (c) FSSAI Licence number shall be indicated on the product packaging wherever applicable. (d) Each pack shall carry mandatory statutory declarations, including product name, net quantity, ingredie nts, batch/lot number, date of manufacture/packing, Best Before/Use By/Expiry date, manufacturer details, FSSAI licence number, MRP and storage instructions, as applicable. 4. PACKAGING (a) Each retail pack shall contain 200 g net quantity. (b) Packaging shall be food-grade, hygienic, properly sealed and suitable for transportation and storage. (c) Packs shall be free from leakage, swelling/bulging, damage, tampering and contamination. (d) Damaged, opened, leaking, tampered or otherwise defective packs shall not be accepted. (e) Outer cartons shall be suitably packed for safe handling and transportation. 5. SHELF LIFE & STORAGE (a) The product shall have a minimum 75% of declared shelf life remaining at the time of delivery, subject to applicable procurement instructions. (b) Expired products shall not be supplied. (c) Product shall be stored and transported as per manufacturer's prescribed storage conditions and applic able food-safety requirements. (d) Where refrigeration/cold-chain is specified on the product label, the prescribed conditions shall be main tained during storage and transportation.

6. BIDDER ELIGIBILITY & DOCUMENTS The bidder shall furnish/upload the following documents along with the bid: (a) Copy of valid FSSAI Licence/Registration. (b) Copy of PAN Card. (c) Copy of GSTIN/GST Registration Certificate. (d) Copy of Cancelled Cheque of the bidder's bank account. (e) Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by the concerned Bank. (f) Valid NCDFA Certificate. (g) Product technical specification/literature. (h) Product label/photograph clearly showing 200 g pack size. (i) Manufacturer details. (j) Undertaking regarding compliance with ATC and technical specifications. (k) Any other document specifically required in the GeM Bid. The product offered and supplied shall be genuine, original and legally marketed. 7. INSPECTION & ACCEPTANCE (a) Inspection shall be carried out by the consignee/authorised representative on receipt of stores. (b) Inspection shall include verification of quantity, pack size, physical condition, batch/lot, manufacturing/ expiry dates, shelf life, labelling and general quality. (c) The Buyer reserves the right to draw representative samples for testing through a Government/NABL-a ccredited/authorised laboratory, wherever considered necessary. (d) Acceptance at the time of receipt shall not absolve the supplier from responsibility for any latent defect /non-conformity subsequently detected. 8. REJECTION & REPLACEMENT The Buyer/Consignee shall have the right to reject the whole or part of the supply in case of: (a) Incorrect item or pack size. (b) Short quantity. (c) Damaged, leaking, swollen or tampered packs. (d) Expired/insufficient shelf-life product. (e) Improper/illegible labelling or invalid statutory details. (f) Mould, rancidity, abnormal odour/taste or contamination. (g) Failure of prescribed quality testing. (h) Any deviation from the stipulated specification. Rejected stores shall be removed and replaced by the supplier with fresh conforming material at his own cost and risk within the period stipulated by the Buyer.

9. QUANTITY & DELIVERY (a) Processed Cheese Spread: 360 packs × 200 g = 72 Kg. (b) The supplier shall deliver the complete quantity at the consignee location specified in the GeM Contrac t. (c) Delivery shall be completed within the delivery period stipulated in the GeM Contract. (d) Short supply shall be made good by the supplier at no additional cost. 10. DELIVERY DOCUMENTS The supplier shall provide, as applicable: (a) Tax Invoice. (b) Delivery Challan. (c) Packing List. (d) Batch/Lot details. (e) Manufacturer details. (f) Quality/Test Certificate, wherever applicable. (g) Other documents required under the GeM Contract. 11. PRICE & PAYMENT (a) Price shall be as per GeM Bid/Contract and shall include all applicable costs as per GeM provisions, incl uding packaging, forwarding, transportation, loading/unloading, insurance and applicable taxes/duties. (b) Payment shall be made as per applicable GeM payment terms after satisfactory delivery, inspection an d acceptance. (c) Payment for rejected/short-supplied quantity shall be subject to satisfactory replacement/completion. 12. LIQUIDATED DAMAGES In case of delay in delivery, Liquidated Damages shall be applicable as per prevailing GeM Genera l Terms & Conditions and the GeM Contract. 13. PRODUCT SUBSTITUTION No substitution of product, manufacturer, brand or pack size shall be made during execution of the contrac t without prior approval of the Buyer and subject to applicable GeM provisions. 14. FOOD SAFETY & STATUTORY COMPLIANCE The supplier shall be responsible for ensuring that the product supplied is safe and fit for human consumpt ion and complies with applicable FSSAI requirements relating to manufacture, packaging, labelling, storag e and transportation. 15. BIDDER'S UNDERTAKING “We certify that the Processed Cheese Spread – 200 g offered by us conforms to th e technical specifications and Additional Terms & Conditions stipulated in the GeM

Bid. We undertake to supply 360 packs of 200 g each, constituting a total net quan tity of 72 Kg. We further undertake that the product supplied shall be genuine, fit for human consumption and compliant with applicable FSSAI requirements. Any rej ected/non-conforming material shall be replaced by us at our own cost and risk as per the terms of the contract.” 16. GENERAL CONDITIONS (a) The bidder shall carefully examine all GeM Bid documents, specifications and ATC before submission of bid. (b) Submission of bid shall be deemed as acceptance of applicable terms and conditions. (c) The Buyer reserves the right to verify licences, documents and product details submitted by the bidder. (d) In case of conflict between this ATC and mandatory GeM provisions, the applicable GeM provisions shal l prevail. (e) Any deviation from the stipulated specification shall require prior approval of the competent authority a nd shall be subject to applicable GeM provisions. GeM BID SUMMARY Particular Processed Cheese Spread Pack Size 200 g Bid Quantity 360 Nos. Total Quantity 72 Kg Intended Use Officers' Ration Inspection Consignee/Authorised Representative Quality Testing As considered necessary Delivery As per GeM Contract Shelf Life Minimum 75% remaining at delivery, subject to applicable procurement instructions Bid Quantity: 360 Nos. (200 g packs) Total Quantity: 72 Kg Quantity in Words: Seventy-Two Kilograms only. .
